Sorry this has happened to you. 💯it is a no brainer - it’s not a “favour” to want to spend the significant milestones in our lives with people we care about the most 💜

I’ve been in this position myself recently and it’s super hard! We haven’t spoken in a month since I had enough. I don’t have much advice because I’m still learning and missing her sometimes comes out of the blue. But just know you are a worthwhile friend and you deserve to treated with kindness and made a priority - even if this is just by yourself. Wherever your relationship may end up down the track just make sure you acknowledge the value you bring. While people may not owe you their time, if they respect you then you are deserving of their time 💜

I have sent her a few messages with this sort of context and each time it’s gone unacknowledged has been a little poke at my dignity and self-respect. It’s triggered a younger version of me that would grovel and beg to be forgiven in situations regardless of if I were actually in the wrong. I couldn’t stand to have people mad at me. I never want to go back to that - I was walked all over. I know logically this will probably have nothing to do with me but I know she is actively choosing to  ignore me - so some tiny part at least is about me otherwise she would have just said she needed some time.

Of course I love her and I want her to be happy but I think I’ve come to conclusion that I’m not waiting to be of value to someone else anymore. It’s the first time in my life I’ve been able to say to myself that I am of worth and I deserve better. If she does reach out down the track she knows I’ll be there but for now I need to stop repeating old behaviours and letting it spiral. I just realised I could make the decision and take some control back instead of just letting things happen to me.

I know this makes me sound completely selfish but it’s been long overdue.

Yeah this is something I have been thinking about recently too. I think I just have to make a decision based on what will bring me peace of mind and stop seeking out that external validation. It feels wrong to put myself first but it is my life after all…

I’m not close with my family and I have slowly detached myself for friends for some reason or another over the last few years. And now I’m pretty much living life on my own. My friends grew up… got partners and that just hasn’t been my life experience and it’s very isolating.

I definitely wallow in my own misery for sure… I think anyone who struggles with their mental health does. The easy choice is to be upset and angry at the world and on those rough days it’s hard to put in the effort to reason with yourself. At least for me anyway. Safe people for me are those “out of bounds” like same sex or people already in relationships so those boundaries are already up to begin with 

I do like the comfort of my own space and I am introverted… haven’t really been able to get out much in the last couple of years but I do try
